limitations: The 8-case micro cohort is fixed reference data; the 14-case end-to-end cohort is source-ranked. Ten of its cases carry over from the previously published measurement rather than being reselected.
Case-level within-model estimates apply to these systems and mechanisms; they are not a universal observability-workload effect.
Null is not estimable, zero means no observed reduction, and a non-significant test does not establish equivalence.

The study has 14 independent cases, and endpoint eligibility leaves only 11-14 cases for an individual test. Exact sign tests on that many cases have low and discrete power, so a non-significant result indicates insufficient evidence and does not establish equivalence.
Provider reasoning settings are frozen configurations, not a common compute scale.
Deterministic evidence sufficiency is reported as a secondary audit and does not control headline efficiency eligibility.
The 40/40/5 capability score is a post-measurement descriptive index. It is not a pre-specified endpoint and its evidence component inherits verifier coverage limits.

Mechanism cohorts are unevenly sized: Workload restart 4, Call-path delay 3, CPU saturation 3, Memory pressure 2, Disk I/O degradation 1, Host unavailable 1. Mechanism-level summaries are descriptive and unevenly supported.

Costs are estimates from frozen provider rates, not invoices, and are kept in the currency each provider billed in. A USD total is a derived figure, converted at the frozen rate published beside it; an exchange rate is a market quote, not a measurement.

research_questions.question: Does the complete GreptimeDB Semantic Graph interface reduce RCA investigation work while preserving diagnosis and evidence validity?

How does the GreptimeDB all-in-one agent-facing interface compare with a Prometheus, Loki and Tempo native interface bundle on the same incidents? The arms differ in store, query languages and tool surface together, so this is an interface-bundle comparison, not an isolated storage effect.
How do the models differ at RCA under each interface?

changes: max_items guidance matches SQL max_rows, with items as the returned unit
split_reruns.execution_amendment: Split-only replay; four ready case environments per cohort, eight globally; two preparations globally and no preparation during investigations; dispatch available providers without blocking worker slots, preserving repetition order within each model and case. Original statistical families remain unchanged. A runner error is persisted as a scoreable failed cell and pauses new dispatch for review; in-flight cells finish and are saved. Explicitly authorized resume skips completed failures; no automatic cell retries. This deliberately pauses the schedule instead of continuing after a runner failure. Gemini HTTP attempts share a local input-token window; waiting counts toward elapsed time but does not consume tool or turn budgets.

retained_encoding_estimate.method: Fixed queries, result values and trajectories; o200k_base payload token differences weighted by later requests and model-specific historical calibration slopes. This does not estimate changed agent behavior.

retry_audit.cost_scope: Additional observed cost from preserved failed attempts only; final published Split cells are priced in the investigation table. Requests without returned usage may have unobserved billed cost.

policy.authorization: 网络等临时性失败允许重新跑cell，跟以前一样，除非是不得不停止的错误，影响正确性和公平性等。
policy.limit_authorization: 一个 cell 最多重新跑3次，我需要设定这个上限，避免预算爆炸。
policy.on_limit: Retain the final scoreable failure, do not spend again for this cell, continue other valid cells unless the failure affects correctness or fairness.
requirements: Only retry a terminal, saved attempt after confirming the process is stopped; never duplicate an active request.
Preserve every failed attempt before retry, bind original and retry hashes, and account for additional spend.
Keep model, prompt, tools, scoring, provider settings, telemetry and budgets fixed.
Use backoff for repeated transient failures; persistent failures require investigation rather than blind repeated spending.
policy.supersedes: The no-cell-retry restriction in manifest-v6 execution_amendment for explicitly temporary failures only.

supervisor_amendments.behavior: The supervisor resumes only after execute has returned, all workers have drained, and the execution lock has been released. It preserves and validates failed attempts, applies the existing three-rerun ceiling, waits 30 seconds, and resumes pending cells. Source, trace, configuration and non-transient failures stop execution. Caffeinate is bound to the supervisor PID.

Preserve Chat Completions finish_reason length as a scored failed cell without retry, and continue remaining scheduled cells. Temporary transport failures retain the existing three-rerun ceiling. Billing, authentication, unknown errors, source, trace and configuration failures still stop. No prompts, tools, budgets, scorer or model settings change.
supervisor_amendments.effective_scope: Next supervisor invocation after the current execute call has drained and released its lock.
